verdict.rationale: Windows has the Microsoft Store as an official app catalog and docs confirm app submission and broad software/accessory compatibility, but the evidence pack never establishes scale ('thousands of apps') or a rich curated catalog experience, and no independent corroboration of catalog breadth is present. missing for 10: evidence of Store catalog size/breadth, independent corroboration of app-ecosystem richness, comparison to third-party app availability outside the Store.
